This script reads and plots environmental data from Hobo loggers. 

# Set Up    

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(seacarb)
library(broom)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
```

# Mortality assessments

## Read in files 

```{r}
data<-read_xlsx("data/mortality.xlsx")%>%select(!notes)%>%filter(!date=="20260107")

metadata<-read_xlsx("data/metadata/experiment_metadata.xlsx")

data<-left_join(data, metadata)%>%select(!`20260107_split`)%>%select(!`20260528_subsample_tag`)
 
data<-data%>%
  mutate(live=as.numeric(live))%>%
  mutate(date=as.factor(date))
```

## Calculate mortality 

```{r}
data$survival<-(data$live/data$starting_oysters)*100
```

## Plot mortality by treatment and family 

```{r}
plot<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=family, y=survival, color=treatment))+
  facet_wrap(~date)+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("blue", "red"))+
  ylab("Survival (%)")+
  xlab("Family")+
  theme_classic(); plot

ggsave(plot, filename="figures/mortality/family_mortality.png", width=8, height=8)
```

```{r}
plot<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=survival, color=treatment))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("blue", "red"))+
  ylab("Mortality (%)")+
  xlab("Date")+
  theme_classic(); plot

ggsave(plot, filename="figures/mortality/treatment_mortality.png", width=4, height=4)
```

## Run model 


```{r}
model2<-data%>%
  
  lmer(survival~treatment*family*as.factor(date) + (1|cage) + (1|tank), data=.)

anova(model2)

qqPlot(residuals(model2))

library(emmeans)
emm<-emmeans(model2, ~treatment | family | date)
pairs(emm)
```

Plot only by family.  

```{r}
plot<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=family, y=survival, color=family))+
  facet_wrap(~date)+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  ylab("Survival (%)")+
  xlab("Family")+
  theme_classic(); plot

ggsave(plot, filename="figures/mortality/family_only_mortality.png", width=8, height=8)
```
